Suggest snacks with nuts or peanut butter I could keep at my desk.

response.text: Here are a few great options for your desk: Almonds, cashews, or mixed nut trail mixes are easy to store. You could also keep individual peanut butter packets to pair with apple slices, celery, or whole-grain crackers.
